title: Exact-transport hierarchy-matched Llama7B router activity power
hypothesis: Applying the checked 419-bit exact VC0 and group-major stats-once VC1 streams to the matching routed bare-router hierarchy will replace the invalid per-wave activity estimate and vectorless router energy without attributing links, aggregate clock tree, endpoint/SRAM, or memory power to the router.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What intrinsic routed energy does one interior router consume for the checked 70,948-flit exact Llama7B transport contract?
include: one full actual-valid-ready VC0 shared-context service phase
four group-major exact stats-once VC1 reduction phases
all five cycle-level RTL/performance replay equivalence gates
all timing-feasible uniquely routed bare-router utilization points
direct VCD and sequential-register activity annotation
separate dynamic and physically feasible leakage energy
exclude: simultaneous VC0 and VC1 arbitration on a shared mesh
synthetic PPA traffic and observation harness
inter-router links and aggregate mesh clock tree

expected_benefit: remove the obsolete 16-bit per-wave activity dependency
replace intrinsic router vectorless power with precision-exact workload activity
preserve energy, area, and timing sensitivity across physical utilization points
provide the exact hierarchy anchor for direct-mesh and endpoint/SRAM composition
risks: five isolated phases do not yet measure cross-VC arbitration
one interior router does not measure aggregate spatial activity, link power, or mesh clock-tree power
raw VCD, ODB, and SPEF stay evaluator-local

required_evaluations.objective: Measure hierarchy-matched routed node-5 activity from the obsolete per-wave schedule.
Measure hierarchy-matched routed node-5 activity power for exact VC0 plus four exact stats-once VC1 phases.
